extracted.name: Pierced Fuzzy Navel
extracted.description: This pierced fuzzy navel recipe is based on a regular fuzzy navel made with peach schnapps and orange juice, but with added vodka and a dash of grenadine.
instruction_lines: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice; add orange juice, peach schnapps, and vodka. Cover and shake until the outside of the shaker has frosted. Strain into a glass. Top with a dash of grenadine.
